html:
SMTO-PSM-0020 — Parameter was not found

GUID: f812d30c-ddf6-48dc-a3c6-59aacd4f3d6f
Slug: parameter-not-found
Domain: PSM · Subsystem: psm

What happened

  • SMTO looked for a saved parameter by name and nothing with that exact name exists now. It may have been renamed or deleted. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Reload the Parameter Store page and use Search parameters… to look for the parameter. It may have been renamed or deleted in another window, or by the Agent, since your page last loaded.
  2. If you find it under a new name, use that name. In a chat message, type @ and pick it from the list. SMTO matches names exactly, and picking from the list inserts the current name.
  3. If it's gone, select New, recreate it with the name you need, and select Save. Requests that name it, such as a database question, can only work once a parameter with that name exists again.

What success looks like

  • The parameter opens in Parameter Store, or your request runs without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the parameter name, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't point the request at a different parameter just because its name looks similar.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Parameter Store get, update, delete or reveal found no record for the key, or a database tool or discovery update found no entry whose normalized key exactly matches the requested one.

What this means

  • Parameter lookup/update/delete returns no record, or profile resolution finds no exact matching normalized key. Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.

Why this can happen

  • Parameter lookup/update/delete returns no record, or profile resolution finds no exact matching normalized key.

How to diagnose it

  • Refresh the intended store and compare the canonical key and scope before writing a replacement.

How to fix it

  • Confirm the key in Parameter Store (GET /api/agent/parameters). The editor routes return 404 when store.get/update/delete/reveal finds nothing; SqlBackend._resolve_profile requires an exact normalized-key match for database_connection profiles. Select an existing key, or create the intended entry explicitly; do not substitute a similarly named entry.
  • Select an existing parameter from the intended store.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • A current existing parameter is selected or an intended new entry is explicitly created.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
